video_subject: High-retention cinematic heartbreak music clip for an Arabic love song, built for TikTok and Instagram Reels. Every shot must contain human movement or emotional action. Phone anxiety, station movement, city-night motion, separation, longing, and a strong final emotional payoff. No generic landscapes, no static slideshow feeling. Use energetic cinematic pacing.
video_script: A man checks his phone alone at night. City lights move around him. The tension rises as crowds cross a station and a train leaves. He walks through the city searching while traffic and pedestrians keep moving around him. The memory of love feels close, then disappears again. The pace rises with movement through the night. The final image leaves him alone, still moving forward as the city keeps rushing past.
